name: Content Strategy & Technical Research
description: Researching technical subjects through SME interviews, reading source code and PRDs, content auditing, documentation strategy, information mapping, lifecycle management, and content gap analysis.

subskills.name: SME Interviewing & Knowledge Elicitation
subskills.description: Conducting structured interviews with software engineers, product managers, and architects to extract complex technical nuances efficiently.

subskills.name: Source Code, Spec & PRD Analysis
subskills.description: Reading codebase pull requests, Jira tickets, RFCs, PRDs, architecture decision records (ADRs), and protobuf/schema definitions to uncover undocumented features.

subskills.name: Content Gap Analysis & User Needs Discovery
subskills.description: Auditing existing documentation to identify missing topics, outdated workflows, broken prerequisites, and unanswered user questions.

subskills.name: Content Lifecycle & Evergreen Maintenance
subskills.description: Managing the end-to-end documentation lifecycle: draft, review, publish, maintain, deprecate, and archive (evergreen content maintenance).

subskills.name: Information Mapping & User Journey Paths
subskills.description: Mapping user onboarding journeys, developer learning paths, task workflows, and decision trees to structured documentation navigation.

subskills.name: Docs-as-a-Product Strategy & Roadmapping
subskills.description: Treating documentation as a core product with discovery, backlog grooming, OKRs, sprint planning, and cross-functional release alignment.

subskills.name: Content Reuse & Single-Sourcing Architecture
subskills.description: Designing single-sourcing architectures, snippet reuse, variables/placeholders, conditional content rendering, and componentized doc structures.

subskills.name: Enterprise Content Auditing & Rot Analysis
subskills.description: Executing qualitative and quantitative content audits across massive documentation repositories, assessing technical debt, readability, and content rot.

subskills.name: Knowledge Base Federation & Unification
subskills.description: Architecting unified documentation ecosystems across engineering, internal wikis (Confluence/Notion), public developer docs, and customer support hubs.

github.signal: Architectural decision records and RFC review involvement
Single-sourcing component reuse, snippets, and partial imports in docs
Documentation roadmaps, OKR tracking, and content sprint backlogs
User journey maps and guided learning paths
Content rot audits, deprecation notices, and federated knowledge configs

Architected single-sourcing content reuse framework and federated internal knowledge bases with public docs

junior.description: Conducts initial SME interviews, reads code diffs/PRDs to identify undocumented features, and spots content gaps.

mid.description: Manages content freshness lifecycles, maps user onboarding journeys, and aligns doc sprints with product launch roadmaps.
